preprocessing_note: Each .mat trial provides sensor_readings with acc_x, acc_y, acc_z, gyro_x, gyro_y, gyro_z. The current project downsamples from 100 Hz to 20 Hz and windows each trial independently.
available_feature_types: physical HAR features including AI, VI, SMA_phys, EVA, CAGH, AVG, AVH, ARATG, DF, ENERGY_phys, AAE, and ARE
note: Use only the hip-worn accelerometer and gyroscope observability. Do not assume video, GPS, object identity, environment context, or subject identity.
